_comment: Template for machine-local overrides. Copy to settings.local.json (gitignored) and edit — never commit real values here. No real secrets belong in either file; runtime scripts read secrets from the environment, never from .claude/settings*.json.

env._comment: Example only — this pack's runtime reads no environment variables today. A per-project stack rule file (see .claude/rules/architecture.md) may document real ones for that project; list their NAMES here if a local override is needed, never their values.
